ch11.card: Part 9 of 10. Learning while it sleeps.
ch11.s01.c1: People sort out the day's lessons while they sleep.
ch11.s01.c2: This model gets a night too. A day of practice, then a night of study.
ch11.s01.c3: Sleep is not a sixth part. It is a way of learning, and so far it has been tested only in research, on earlier-design copies.
ch11.s02.c1: By day, the model gets puzzles with a hidden rule. 2 gives 5. 4 gives 9. 7 gives 15.
ch11.s02.c2: It tries rules. A try counts only if it fits every example, so no answer key is needed.
ch11.s02.c3: Only x times 2 plus 1 fits all three, so 10 gives 21. That try is kept, and the night studies it. This is a made-up example.
ch11.s03.c1: The old sleep scored 71.3 out of 100 on first tries, and needed 558 to 610 updates, by its formula. An update is one small nudge to every setting.
ch11.s03.c2: The newer sleep used 256 updates a night, and averaged 76.1 over six copies.
ch11.s03.c3: But this is not a paired comparison. 71.3 is the old sleep's stored number, from its own near-copy starting copies. Each copy slept once.
ch11.s04.c1: In a night, the model makes its own tries, then sleeps for 256 updates of 1,024 rows. A row is one practice question. This is a picture only.
ch11.s04.c2: Half the rows are fresh dreams: new questions written from a program it found, so none is read twice. The other half are fresh skills rows.
ch11.s04.c3: Every 32 updates, it checks itself on 128 held questions, and keeps its best saved model.
ch11.s05.c1: Did old skills get worse than before the sleep? No. Pooled over the six copies, they rose by 0.52 points, with a likely range of 0.31 to 0.74.
ch11.s05.c2: But a control that only practised the same skills rows raised them by 2.11, with a range of 1.88 to 2.32.
ch11.s05.c3: So sleep did not beat plain practice: sleep minus control is minus 1.58. The gain is not shown to come from the sleep.
ch11.s06.c1: New since Oct 9. A two-night recipe, called SCM2, passed its test on 2 copies. Night, a day of search, night. It was reported by the research team, and not rechecked.
ch11.s06.c2: Here is the skills score, out of 100. Copy 1 had 86.7 before. After the standard two nights it fell to 82.9. After SCM2 it was 87.8.
ch11.s06.c3: Copy 2 had 87.8 before, 84.7 after the standard two nights, and 89.3 after SCM2. So, no forgetting.
ch11.s06.c4: Learning kept up. On multi-step puzzles, first try against the standard two nights was minus 1.9 and plus 1.9. The pass mark was no worse than minus 2.
ch11.s06.c5: Only 2 copies so far. A check on more copies is still to come.
ch11.s07.c1: Planned, not done: sleep becomes part of the first big training run.
ch11.s07.c2: The 100M training itself stays as it is. After it comes a day-and-night phase, and the SCM2 nights are its recipe.
ch11.s07.c3: First, it must pass on smaller test models, at 3M and then 10M. Those tests have not run yet. The results so far are from earlier-design copies.
ch11.s07.c4: The planned time is about a week after the main training. That is an estimate, and not measured.
ch11.s08.c1: Sleep is a night of study after a day of practice. The newer sleep scored 76.1 in 256 updates, but not in a paired test.
ch11.s08.c2: Two nights in a row kept old skills, on 2 copies. Sleep in the first big run is planned, not done.
ch11.s08.c3: Next, Part 10. Creative mode: what it does when it gets stuck.
